Apple yesterday released iOS 27.2 beta 3 to developers, containing multiple changes and hinting at upcoming features. Below is everything new in this latest beta.

iOS 27.2 beta 3 details

Apple released iOS 27.2 beta 3 to developers on Monday, with build number 24B5099f, two weeks after the previous second beta. A new public beta followed on Tuesday, with the official release expected to roll out to everyone before month's end.

What's new in iOS 27.2 beta 3?

New Apple Music logo

When Apple announced Apple Music Hall last month, it teased a new Apple Music logo, and iOS 27.2 beta 3 shows this new logo is about to be fully adopted. The new logo uses a bolder font than the previous one, and the "m" in "music" has also been changed to lowercase.

Apple has also begun using the new logo in the Apple Music sign-up flow in iOS 27.2 beta 3.

New Messages settings in development

Code in iOS 27.2 beta 3 shows that Apple is working on a new setting that gives users more control over managing suggested actions in the Messages app, such as the "Add to Calendar" button.

The code suggests users will be able to disable suggested actions for individual apps, including Calendar, Reminders, Notes, and Maps. This change is not yet enabled, and Apple may also cancel it before the official release.

Apple Books design tweaks

According to Beta Profiles on X, iOS 27.2 beta 3 brings new Liquid Glass design changes to the Apple Books app, and also adds a new reading progress bar for easier tracking of reading progress.

macOS 27.2 beta 3: Hints at a touchscreen Mac

Outside expectations are that Apple may announce a MacBook Pro with a touchscreen as early as this month. macOS 27.2 beta 3 further hints that Apple is working hard to optimise macOS for touch operation, adding new "gesture recognition tools" to several Apple built-in apps in this update.

The Dock also has a new long-press animation that looks very suitable for touch operation:

More details

  • According to Aaron Perris, code in iOS 27.2 beta 3 shows that "nearby smart home accessories may display control options in the Dynamic Island".
  • According to Beta Profiles, the new beta has slightly redesigned the battery icon in the Settings app and elsewhere in iOS.
  • Apple Fitness and Apple TV apps also have new launch screens.

Summary

Have you found anything else new in iOS 27.2 beta 3? Feel free to share with us in the comments section.
